description: General government gross debt for one European country each quarter, as a % of GDP (default) or in millions of euro. Answers "how big is Greece's or Italy's national debt" for investors, students and reporters. Source: Eurostat dataset gov_10q_ggdebt (Maastricht debt, consolidated). Quarterly ratios can differ from the annual figures used in EU deficit procedures. (cost: 1 credit)

geo.description: string, required, 2-letter Eurostat country code (DE, FR, ES, IT, NL, PL, EL = Greece) or country name; EU27_2020, EA (euro area), EA21, EA20 also accepted. EU, EFTA and EU candidate countries only (no UK)

n.description: integer, optional, most recent quarters, 1-100, default 8

unit.description: string, optional: 'PC_GDP' (% of GDP, default) or 'MIO_EUR' (millions of euro)

name: eu_government_debt_ratio
